newsitem.title: CHINA: Sinopec to take control of Yizheng - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sinopec to take control of Yizheng - paper.

text.p: China's State Council has assigned China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) to take control of Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd from the China National Textile Council as part of a merger deal between China enterprises, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Saturday.

The South China Morning Post quoted a source from a Japanese brokerage firm as saying there would be a share swap between the ministries that would see Sinopec becoming the ultimate parent of Yizheng, one of the world's biggest polyester manufacturers.

The source said it was a logical move because the merger involved Sinopec's two largest entreprises -- Yangzi Petrochemical and Jinling Petrochemical -- along with Nanjing Chemical Industrial Group, controlled by the Ministry of Chemical Industries.
The merger would eliminate overlapping expansion plans among the four, notably between Yangzi and Yizheng, the source said.
Officials from the company were not immediately available for comment.
Yizheng, based in Jiangsu province, said earlier this month that the Chinese government was studying the possibility of a merger, but it had not received any formal notification of merger plan.
